title: OgAttribution
description: Blueprint 6.10. content/og_attribution.json as shipped: a render `policy` statement plus one entry per narrative recorded by scripts/fetch-og. status fallback means the styled placeholder ships, and then the original url and fetch date may be null.

seed.description: Quarantine flag on transcribed seed fixtures (Gate 2). Optional, true only, and absent from every artifact in content/: check 7 (slug seed) is this field's validator coverage and fails any content root that carries it. The root stays closed otherwise.

image_path.description: Additive optional (member link previews): the staged asset path for this preview, e.g. /assets/og/members/mbg-stop-m1.jpg. The licence gate matches files to entries by this path's basename.

member_url.description: Additive optional: the family-member article this preview belongs to. Absent on the ten original narrative-level entries.
